top_signals.title: Persian Gulf Oil Exports Recover, Centcom Says Hormuz Is Mine Free
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs analysts say oil exports from the Persian Gulf have recovered to around two-thirds of pre-war levels, limiting the Iran war’s impact on global crude prices. Meanwhile the top US commander for the Middle East said that American forces have cleared Iranian mines from the Strait of Hormuz, after Washington’s allies expressed doubts about similar claims by President Donald Trump. Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: El Niño to Crimp Indonesian Palm Oil Output, Producer Group Says
top_signals.summary: Indonesia’s palm oil production may shrink by up to 3 million tons next year due to the severe El Niño weather forecast for the coming months, according to an industry estimate, adding to upward pressure on prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid Canada trade war
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump signed an executive order that he said will "immediately" change the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yokohama mayor set to resign over allegations of power harassment
top_signals.summary: Takeharu Yamanaka's resignation would start the clock for an election to take place within 50 days.
